items.description: Cleaning of affected floor, utility room
items.rationale: Escape of water from a washing machine hose is covered under 2.4.2(b). Cleaning affected surfaces is a repair cost under 7.1.7(h); rate taken as a share of the comparable Case 12 flat rate.
The hallway was affected by the escaped water, so cleaning is covered under 7.1.7(h). Rate is a share of the Case 12 flat rate.
Confirming the source no longer discharges is covered under 7.1.7(e), even though the appliance itself is not insured.
Taking down and disposing of affected components is covered under 7.1.7(a) and 5.2.1; skirting is fixed trim under 4.2.2.
Reinstating the affected building component like for like under 7.1.1(b) and 7.1.7(c).
The bedroom was not reached by the water, so the work falls outside the affected parts and is excluded under 3.5 and 7.1.5.
Moisture measurement is covered under 7.1.7(b). Rate follows the Case 21 moisture measurement (153-178).
Drying the affected rooms is covered under 7.1.7(b). Rate is a share of the Case 12 drying flat rate (605-680).
Hire of drying equipment is covered under 7.1.7(e). Customary rental rate applied.
Trade labour is covered under 7.1.7(g). Price prior of about 38 per hour x 4 hours gives about 152.
The basement storage room was not affected, and drying does not extend to other rooms under 7.1.7(b) and 7.1.5, so the line is excluded.

Covered under 5.2.6, but the item was not scheduled, so a EUR 1,000 net (1,190 gross) limit applies per painting. The limit is set first against restoration, which likely exhausts it; any balance goes to this line first in invoice order.
Falls under the same 5.2.6 per-item limit. Only a balance left after restoration and transport would be paid, which is likely nil.
Falls under the same 5.2.6 limit and is last in invoice order, so it is likely exhausted by restoration.
Under 5.2.6 the limit is applied first to restoration. With the item not scheduled, the cap is EUR 1,000 net, i.e. 1,190 gross, which full restoration of a valuable painting likely reaches.

items.description: Restoration of second painting in basement
items.rationale: This painting was unaffected by the insured event, so there is no cover under 5.2.6 or 7.1.5.
Administrative and handling charges are not a repair cost under 7.1.8(b).
